about: CCwiki's reviewed corrections for deriving relations from the wiki's relations.json. The manifest does not record hardness regimes, scoped notions, refutations or per-direction equivalence classes; these entries supply them until it does. Every entry cites the wiki's own text (a reduction's Statement or securityLoss, or an assumption page). Spec: plans/derivations.md section 2a. Read by scripts/derivations_reference.py and by the Swift Derivation type; the corpus test fails if an id here no longer resolves.

refuted.text: Public-coin circular evasive LWE is false (AMYY25).
SIDH is broken classically in polynomial time (CD22).
SSDDH is the decisional variant of SIDH, which CD22 breaks classically in polynomial time from the same transcript.

settings.text: A corruption setting, not an assumption: MPC with t < n/2 exists unconditionally given broadcast (RB89).
A corruption setting, not an assumption: MPC with t < n/3 exists unconditionally (BGW88).

quarantine.reason: The Statement needs composite-order groups and three assumptions jointly (DBDH, bilinear subgroup decision, C3DH); the record has the single prime-order hypothesis bdh.
The Statement assumes evasive LWE together with LWE; the record drops the LWE conjunct. Evasive LWE is an implication-form assumption and does not imply LWE.
The Statement assumes evasive LWE, tensor LWE and LWE; the record drops the LWE conjunct.

red-cpa-security-to-cpa-security.note: GM84 and MRS88 prove the two directions; both are black-box.

red-isis-inhomogeneous-sis-to-sis.note: SIS => ISIS is immediate; ISIS => SIS holds only under conditions on the column count and norm bound (requires entry below).

red-linear-secret-sharing-schemes-lsss-t.note: KW93 and Bei96: both directions are size-preserving translations.

red-module-lwe-to-lwe-ls15.note: Degree-1 module LWE is LWE with the same parameters.

red-module-lwe-to-ring-lwe-ls15.note: Rank-1 module LWE is Ring LWE with the same parameters.

red-rabin-ot-to-ot.note: Cre87: each direction is an information-theoretic protocol.

red-rsa-to-fac-dlo24.note: RSA => FAC is trivial in the standard model, FAC => RSA is DLO24's generic-ring theorem; the recorded model 'other' is kept for both, which only under-claims the trivial direction.

requires.notion: SXDH sub-exponentially hard, on asymmetric bilinear groups of prime order p = O(2^lambda)
requires.evidence: Statement: 'Assume sub-exponential hardness of the following: SXDH on asymmetric bilinear groups of prime order p = O(2^lambda)'; securityLoss: 'requires sub-exponential hardness of all four hypotheses'

requires.notion: LWE sub-exponentially hard over Z_p (p the SXDH group order), with modulus-to-noise ratio 2^(k^eps)
requires.evidence: Statement: 'LWE over Z_p with secret dimension k and modulus-to-noise ratio 2^{k^eps}'

requires.notion: LPN sub-exponentially hard over the field Z_p (not binary LPN), with polynomially many samples and error rate l^(-delta)
requires.evidence: Statement: 'LPN over Z_p (the field generalization, not binary LPN) with secret dimension l, polynomially many samples and error rate l^{-delta}'

requires.notion: a sub-exponentially secure Boolean PRG in NC0 with stretch n^(1+tau)
requires.evidence: Statement: 'a Boolean PRG in NC0 with stretch n^{1+tau} on n-bit seeds', under sub-exponential hardness

requires.notion: decision LWE with modulus-to-noise ratio exponential in the depth bound L
requires.evidence: Statement: 'IND-CPA-secure if decision LWE is hard with modulus-to-noise ratio exponential in L'. Reg05 gives prime poly(n) modulus only (red-gapsvp-to-lwe-reg05 Statement).

requires.notion: quasi-polynomial hardness of low-noise LPN with noise rate O(log^(1+beta)(k)/k)
requires.evidence: Statement: 'Quasi-polynomial hardness of low-noise LPN in dimension k with noise rate O(log^{1+beta}(k)/k)'

requires.notion: public-key FE for P/poly that is single-key, sub-exponentially secure and weakly compact
requires.evidence: Statement: 'A public-key FE scheme for P/poly that is single-key, sub-exponentially secure and weakly compact'; securityLoss: 'requires sub-exponentially secure FE'. SW14 (red-hash-function-and-io-to-fe-sw14) gives selectively secure IND-based FE.

requires.notion: ISIS with the column count and norm bound under which ISIS hardness implies SIS hardness
requires.evidence: Statement: 'The other, ISIS hardness implying SIS hardness ... holds only under conditions on the column count and norm bound.'

requires.notion: a doubly enhanced, certified trapdoor permutation family
requires.evidence: Statement: 'A family of doubly enhanced, certified trapdoor permutations ... yields a NIZK proof system'. RSA78's TDP (red-rsa-to-tdp-rsa78) is not stated to be certified.

requires.notion: constant-noise LPN that is 2^(k^(1/2+delta))-hard, or 2^(Omega(k/log k))-hard with poly(k) samples
requires.evidence: Statement: '2^{k^{1/2+delta}}-hard for a constant delta > 0 (subexponential LPN with exponent above 1/2)'. The variant is defined as 2^{omega(k^eps)} for some eps > 0 (learning-parity-with-noise.md:83).

requires.notion: constant-noise LPN that is 2^(omega(n^(1/2)))-hard with advantage at most 1/T
requires.evidence: Statement: 'Constant-noise LPN that is 2^{omega(n^{1/2})}-hard'. The variant fixes only some eps > 0.

requires.notion: constant-noise LPN that is 2^(omega(n^(1/2)))-hard with advantage at most 1/T
requires.evidence: Statement: 'Constant-noise LPN that is 2^{omega(n^{1/2})}-hard'. The variant fixes only some eps > 0.

requires.notion: LPN that is 2^(O(sqrt n))-hard
requires.evidence: Statement: '2^{O(sqrt n)}-hardness of LPN'. The variant fixes only some eps > 0.

requires.notion: LPN that is 2^(O(sqrt n))-hard
requires.evidence: Statement: '2^{O(sqrt n)}-hardness of LPN'. The variant fixes only some eps > 0.

requires.notion: DLOG hard in Z_p^* (p prime, g a generator)
requires.evidence: Statement: 'If DLOG is hard in Z_p^* (p prime, g a generator), the Blum-Micali generator is a PRG'. DLOG derived from CDH, DDH or BDH lives in their group, not Z_p^*.

requires.notion: a perfectly correct CPA-secure PKE with certifiable keys
requires.evidence: Statement: 'turns any perfectly correct CPA-secure PKE into a non-interactive commitment ... A malicious committer may choose a malformed pk unless keys are certifiable'. Notes (pke-to-com.md:30) give the route without either: PKE => OWF => PRG => COM.

requires.notion: a CP-IND-CPA-secure ciphertext-policy ABE whose policy class contains disjunctions
requires.evidence: Statement: 'Take a CP-ABE scheme ... If the scheme is CP-IND-CPA-secure'. KW19 (rw13 edge) and Wee25 state CP-ABE; GPSW06 is KP-ABE.

requires.notion: OT secure against malicious parties (it instantiates Kil88's ideal OT)
requires.evidence: Statement: 'in the OT-hybrid model every two-party functionality can be computed with unconditional security against malicious parties'. The OT page's definitions are semi-honest (oblivious-transfer.md:107); EGL's OT is semi-honest. DMO00's Statement: 'single-server PIR is therefore complete for secure two-party and multi-party computation'.

requires.notion: OT secure against malicious parties (it instantiates Kil88's ideal OT)
requires.evidence: Statement: 'in the OT-hybrid model there is a bit commitment that is statistically hiding and statistically binding'. The OT page's definitions are semi-honest (oblivious-transfer.md:107).

statementLint.red-evasive-lwe-to-abe: Reviewed: the Statement names evasive LWE as the family circular evasive LWE belongs to, not as a second hypothesis.
statementLint.red-partially-homomorphic-encryption-phe: Reviewed: DDH and DCR are named as examples of linearly homomorphic PKE, not as hypotheses.

weakens.evidence: Statement: 'a key-policy ABE ... that is selectively KP-IND-CPA-secure'. The ABE page defines adaptive security; selective is a variant (attribute-based-encryption.md:110-112).

weakens.notion: an invertible PRF for the forward-oracle game only, over a super-polynomial domain
weakens.evidence: Statement: 'is an invertible PRF for the traditional (forward-oracle) game ... Strong security under Game^iprf ... fails for every permutation'. The forward game is the PRF game, so iPRF => PRF accepts it.
